usability: Define Usability clearly and explain where it fits within UX Principles.
Understand the core purpose of Usability and the problem it is meant to solve.
Learn the main concepts, terminology, and mental models related to Usability.
Study how Usability works internally step by step in real application flow.
Compare Usability with related alternatives and know when each approach is better.
Identify common implementation patterns, best practices, and typical pitfalls in Usability.
Practice Usability with small examples before applying it in larger UI/UX Engineering projects.
Understand performance, scalability, accessibility, or security concerns connected to Usability.
Learn how to debug, test, and validate behavior when working with Usability.
Be able to explain Usability in interviews using practical examples and tradeoffs.
